page.overview:
Who is Komo?

Komo is the name of the bear spirit Nightwolf can summon in Mortal Kombat 11, alongside the wolf spirit, Kiba, and the eagle spirit, Hana. When summoned, any damage Nightwolf takes is decreased for a limited amount of time.

Komo also appears in one of Nightwolf's Fatalities, where Nightwolf summons it to tear the opponent in half and fling both parts of their body away. Category:Minor Characters Category:Good Characters Category:Characters Category:Animals Category:Mortal Kombat 11 Characters
